nodes.statement: The frozen audit already recovers the proposed-tool-call signal from post-run response fields in 21/21 known strict-fail tasks and 29/30 strict-pass tasks, so a new generation is not needed to discover or cover that signal. The earlier low complete-call coverage (3/21 known-fail and 4/30 strict-pass tasks) belongs to the post-execution validated_args recount, not to the proposed-call extraction. The partial exact-repeat recount records 1 repeat among 967 eligible starts and 23 unknown starts in the known-strict-fail cohort, versus 0 among 971 eligible and 47 unknown in the strict-pass cohort, so no complete-cohort rate comparison is admitted. The reviewed live pre-exec hook exposes tool_name and parsed_tool_args, but parsed live arguments are not verified to equal executed arguments or post-execution validated_args. The bounded question is whether an inert, sidecar-only live observation agrees with the post-run structural signal and reproduces its pattern in one new unpaired frozen run, without causal or strict-gain claims.

nodes.falsification_condition: Concordance is falsified if any co-covered task-step with complete live and post-run records receives a different canonical repeat or nonrepeat category, or if live per-task repeat counts are incompatible with post-run counts after excluding declared unknown or unmatched records, or if the sidecar changes any agent-visible input, dispatch sequence, tool result, or scoring. If per-cohort complete coverage is below 0.8, the result is inconclusive Evidence for concordance and is not a launch veto or evidence of signal absence. A stochastic difference in the structural pattern alone does not establish falsification or causality.
nodes.possible_counterexample: Live parsed arguments may not match executed arguments; the live hook and post-run normalization may not align one-to-one; exact repeated calls may be legitimate state-dependent re-queries; coverage may remain below 80%; and one stochastic unpaired run may produce a different pattern without any treatment effect. The sidecar may also agree with the post-run trace while adding no diagnostic value beyond the frozen audit.
nodes.prediction: In the single formal child run over the identical frozen 56 no-hint tasks with the identical 1200-second per-task limit and strict all-56 scoring: (1) the sidecar records a defined signal category for every observed reviewed-hook step and reports anonymous per-task coverage; (2) on co-covered task-steps, canonical live repeat and nonrepeat categories agree with the post-run derived categories; (3) the sidecar-derived pattern is reported separately by known-strict-fail, strict-pass, timeout, and unknown cohorts, with the earlier sparse partial pattern used as a comparison rather than a guaranteed point estimate; (4) no strict-pass increase is predicted, and no cohort rate is asserted when complete-task coverage is below 0.8. One unpaired run cannot establish causality.
nodes.statement: At the reviewed live pre-exec hook, a write-only sidecar reading only tool_name and parsed_tool_args will produce the same within-task exact proposed-call repetition categories as the post-run trace after the declared canonicalization on co-covered task-steps, and will yield a comparable sparse structural pattern in one new unpaired frozen run. The signal is already derivable before this run; this tests live-hook concordance, coverage, and reproducibility, not discovery, correctness, or causality.

engineering_acceptance_criteria: The code_parent is executable and resolves to the bound g002_lifecycle_stage source; launch is blocked otherwise.
The runtime hook is exactly DataAgentWithSelfObservation._handle_tool_call and the observation occurs before exec.

Source fields used are only live tool_name and parsed_tool_args; validated_args, tool_call_index, raw_arguments, messages, results, task IDs, answers, and digest strings are not persisted by the sidecar.
Static data-flow review and hook-local tests prove the sink is sidecar-only, write-only, non-blocking, and not fed to the agent.
Enabled and disabled sidecar paths produce identical hook control flow, return values, messages, dispatch, and scoring in prelaunch tests.
The exact frozen protocol is bound: 56 no-hint tasks, 1200 seconds per task, strict pass over all 56, timeouts counted as failures, and one formal run only.
The sidecar schema accepts only anonymous_task_index, step_index, signal_category, repeat_count, eligible_step_count, and coverage_status.
Coverage below 0.8 per cohort is reported as Evidence and does not veto launch.
All outputs preserve unknown categories and avoid causal or strict-gain claims.
nodes.expected_behavior: The agent and evaluator behave as in the bound parent, while the sidecar appends anonymous per-task-step structural records. No strict-pass gain is expected from instrumentation. The formal run reports the fixed outcome partition and live/post-run concordance descriptively; missing or unmatched records remain unknown rather than being imputed.
nodes.frozen_evaluation: Exactly one formal candidate evaluation over the same frozen 56 no-hint tasks, the same single 1200-second per-task wall limit, the same harness and evidence-integrity binding, and strict pass over all 56 tasks with timeouts counted as failures. No task is added, removed, re-scored, or reinterpreted; no answer, hint, validator, held-out data, or prior graph is used; no second arm, sham run, or probe run is added. The run reports the 21 known-strict-fail, 2 timeout-failure, 3 strict-verdict-unknown cases and the strict-pass reference separately, with coverage below 0.8 recorded as an Evidence result rather than a launch veto.
nodes.implementation_scope: One hook-local sidecar at DataAgentWithSelfObservation._handle_tool_call in g002_lifecycle_stage. No prompt, policy, tool, task, timing, retry, error-handling, result-storage, or scoring changes; no blocking or suppression; no extra formal evaluation; no raw content persistence. The implementation must be source-bound, executable, and proven inert before launch.
nodes.intervention: Add one write-only sidecar observation sink at the reviewed live pre-exec hook DataAgentWithSelfObservation._handle_tool_call in the bound code parent. Copy only tool_name and parsed_tool_args, canonicalize them in memory, compare the current canonical pair with earlier canonical proposed calls in the same anonymous task, and persist only the allowed structural fields. Do not mutate arguments, block a call, inject a message, feed the agent, change tool dispatch, alter error handling, alter result storage, or alter scoring.

measurement_plan.aggregation: Report per-task repeat_count and eligible_step_count, plus category and unknown counts. Cohort summaries use only complete-coverage tasks, with incomplete tasks reported separately. The known-strict-fail, timeout-failure, strict-verdict-unknown, and strict-pass reference groups are never pooled to mask missing coverage, and no correctness or causal contrast is inferred.
measurement_plan.canonicalization: Perform all canonicalization in memory only. Compare tool_name as an exact string. Canonicalize parsed_tool_args as JSON with object keys sorted recursively, compact separators, array order preserved, and JSON number, string, boolean, and null semantics preserved. A parse or canonicalization failure marks the step unknown; raw forms are never logged.
measurement_plan.coverage_guard: Complete-task coverage per cohort is the number of tasks with a valid live sidecar record for every eligible reviewed-hook step and a matched post-run structural record, divided by all tasks in that cohort. Report numerator and denominator separately. Below 0.8, withhold complete-cohort rate comparisons and report low coverage as an Evidence result, not a launch veto or signal absence.
measurement_plan.falsification_test: Among complete-coverage co-covered tasks, any disagreement in canonical signal category or any per-task repeat-count incompatibility beyond declared unknown or unmatched records falsifies exact concordance. If either cohort has complete-task coverage below 0.8, the concordance estimate is inconclusive Evidence rather than a launch veto. Any sidecar-induced change to agent-visible input, dispatch, results, or scoring voids the experiment.
limitations: Parsed_tool_args_match_executed_args is not verified, so live and executed calls may differ.
The live hook may not align one-to-one with post-run normalized trace steps.
Exact repeats may be legitimate state-dependent re-queries and do not imply obstruction.
Coverage may fall below 80 percent; this is an Evidence result, not a launch veto.
One unpaired frozen run cannot establish causality, treatment effects, or a strict-pass gain.
The sidecar cannot reveal wrong reasoning, unsupported claims, or answer quality.
The two timeout cases lack normalized full traces, so their final in-flight operation remains unknown.
measurement_plan.negative_control: The sidecar is a write-only shadow sink. Prelaunch enabled-versus-disabled hook tests must show identical control flow, return values, messages, dispatch, and scoring. In the formal run no second arm is used, no sidecar output is read by the agent, and any behavior change attributable to the sink invalidates the instrumentation.
measurement_plan.negative_rule: A live step is signal_category nonrepeat when both source fields are parseable and canonicalizable and the pair differs from every earlier canonical pair in the same anonymous task.
measurement_plan.observability_prediction: The sidecar will produce anonymous structural records at the reviewed hook. On co-covered complete tasks, canonical live categories are expected to match post-run categories. The earlier partial pattern of one repeat among 967 eligible known-fail starts and zero among 971 eligible strict-pass starts is a comparison reference, not a guaranteed point estimate. No strict-pass increase is predicted.
measurement_plan.positive_rule: A live step is signal_category repeat when its canonical tool_name and parsed_tool_args pair exactly equals any earlier canonical pair in the same anonymous task.

prior_observation.exploratory_value: The signal is already frozen-recoverable and is not being discovered here. The run's only exploratory value is whether the live pre-exec interface observes the same structural repetition categories as the post-run trace, what coverage the live interface achieves, and whether the sparse pattern is reproducible in one unpaired run.

semantic_boundary: Exact repetition is a structural category only; it does not establish wasted work, obstruction, correctness, or causality.
Parsed live arguments are not verified to equal executed arguments, so this study measures the hook-visible interface only.
No answer, tool-result, validator, message, hint, task, or held-out content is inspected or persisted.
The experiment is exploratory observability instrumentation with no strict-gain prediction.
A single unpaired run cannot establish a treatment effect or a cohort-level causal contrast.
measurement_plan.task_specific_instantiation: Within each unchanged task, the first observed live proposed call begins the comparison chain. Each later reviewed-hook step is compared only with earlier canonical proposed calls in the same anonymous task. The post-run comparison uses structural task-step ordinals under the declared canonicalization, with no task-specific logic or special casing.
measurement_plan.unknown_rule: A step is signal_category unknown when either source field is missing, parsing or canonicalization fails, the sidecar record is absent, the post-run counterpart is missing, or the steps cannot be aligned under the declared canonicalization. Never infer repeat or nonrepeat for an unknown step.

nodes.negative_control: No treatment arm and no formal control run. Launch requires static data-flow proof plus hook-local regression tests showing that the sidecar disabled versus enabled on the same synthetic hook inputs produces identical control flow, return values, messages, dispatch, and scoring. In the formal run the sidecar is write-only and is never read by the agent; any agent-visible read or behavioral change invalidates the inertness claim.
safety_questions: Does the intervention preserve the no-hint protocol and avoid all task, answer, validator, hint, and held-out content?
Is the bound parent executable, and does its reviewed source tree match the selected code_parent?
Is the runtime hook exactly the reviewed live pre-exec hook, with observation occurring before exec?
Can the sidecar be proven inert, with no agent-visible input, no execution or dispatch mutation, and no scoring change?
Does every formal run use exactly the frozen 56 tasks, the 1200-second per-task limit, and strict all-56 scoring with timeouts as failures?
Can the logger reject raw arguments, messages, results, digest strings, task IDs, and answer content?
Does the design avoid treating post-execution validated_args or post-run tool_call_index as live pre-dispatch fields?
Are parse failures, missing hook records, and unmatched post-run steps explicitly classified as unknown rather than imputed?

limits: Structural concordance does not establish task progress, answer correctness, or causal gain.
The two runner timeouts are failures in the fixed 56 denominator and lack normalized full traces.
Three completed strict verdicts remain unknown and are not reclassified as adjudicated failures.
This is one unpaired run; score differences from earlier generations are descriptive only.
nodes.statement: G3 live proposed-call structural concordance on the frozen no-hint 56.
